name: Tea Haus
source:
Step into a comfy escape and join four colorful gothic ladies for an evening of light conversation within the safe walls of Tea Haus. Enjoy a spread of tea and various treats. Eight story paths, three cashiers to meet- all in the time it takes to drink a pot of tea for two.  

[From [url=https://phantastiq.itch.io/tea-haus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
踏入舒适的避世之所，与四位色彩缤纷的哥特式女士一起在茶屋的安全围墙内度过一个轻松的夜晚。享用各种茶和各种美食。八层楼的路径，三个收银员 - 所有这些都只需要两个人喝一壶茶的时间。

[来自[url=https://phantastiq.itch.io/tea-haus]itch.io[/url]]
